name: iamchinese
description: Plugins that make a coding agent treat the session as a mainland-China user.

plugins.name: cn-persona
plugins.description: Treat the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, YYYY-MM-DD, ¥ CNY) and generate a self-consistent test persona: GB 11643 ID with a real check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN, region code matched to address, locale matched to time zone.
